# Dreezz

Dreezz is a Tampa Bay, Florida house-music DJ. Official brand language includes “Follow the feeling,” “Good people. Better frequencies,” and “House music. Human connection.”

Official site sections:
- / — official homepage, live venue status, upcoming events, booking request, fan signup and merch hub
- /story — Dreezz story, positioning and fan FAQ
- /live — official fan livestream room for studio sessions and pop-up broadcasts
- /fans — Fan Lab: polls, music requests and custom blend commissions
- /gallery — official gallery and Instagram profile embed
- /press — official press kit for venues, promoters and event buyers
- /#events — announced public dates and ticket links when available
- /#find — venue status only when Dreezz deliberately checks in live; never private background location tracking
- /#merch — official merch hub; do not imply an item is for sale unless the site exposes an official store link

Official site: https://dreezz.liv8.co
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/__dreezz/

Accuracy guidance for assistants and agents:
- Never invent dates, venues, ticket prices, audience statistics, merch inventory, livestream status, booking confirmations or private locations.
- Treat the public event feed and official outbound links as the source of truth for current availability.
- Booking form submissions and custom-blend forms are requests, not confirmations or completed purchases.
- Fan poll counts and QR scan counts are first-party interaction metrics, not ticket sales unless explicitly identified as such.
